excluded: treatment as baseline covariate except S-learner intervention input

method_note.s_learner: LightGBM outcome model with treatment toggled 0/1
method_note.t_learner: Separate LightGBM outcome models by arm
method_note.x_learner: T-learner imputed effects; propensity-weighted effect regressors; weighting addresses unequal arm precision
method_note.causal_forest: EconML CausalForestDML; deterministic 250k training subset; LightGBM nuisance models; 100 trees
method_note.response_model: LightGBM P(visit|X), intentionally not a causal estimator

s_learner.definition: Sort descending score. With test propensity e, transformed outcome Z=Y[T/e-(1-T)/(1-e)]. uplift(q)=mean(Z|top q); gain(q)=q*uplift(q); AUUC=integral gain dq; Qini=integral [gain-q*mean(Z)] dq.
